newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Unibanco still an ING buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Unibanco still an ING buy.

text.p: ING Barings on Tuesday said it had reiterated its buy rating on Brazil's Unibanco following improvement in the bank's fundamentals and the significant underperformance of its ADRs.
- said the bank's reported second quarter earnings of $0.97 per ADR was mainly driven by lower loan loss provisions, additional reduction in the cost structure and good non-interest income.

- "We remain positive on Unibanco's fundamentals and profitability profile in the long-term. We are encouraged by the significant improvement in asset quality and the additional reduction in costs during the quarter," said analysts Nuno Fernandes and Beltran Estrada in a report.
- They said the stock has underperformed the local index by 12 percent and by more than 15 percent its main competitors in the past month.
- also said its June 1998 price target of $44.7 represent a 36 percent total return, including a 4.9 percent dividend yield.
- Unibanco preferred was up 3.02 percent at 37.50 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bolsa. Its ADR was at 35-1/4, up 1/03.
